about_the_game:
Diversify your diesel fleet along the Northeast Corridor in Train Sim World 5 with the addition of the HSP46! Operate MBTA’s busy Providence/Stoughton Line with modern motive power, serving the commuters of Massachusetts with double-deck duty.

Built between 2013 and 2014, the HSP46 marked a new era for MBTA as they were able to replace ageing equipment on their key commuter services into the city of Boston. Putting passengers first from the offset, MBTA allowed members of the public to pick the livery for this new fleet of locomotives, resulting in a striking application of angled magenta, accented with yellow, grey and black.

Originally released as part of the MBTA Commuter: Framingham/Worcester Line, the HSP46 now comes raring for service along the high-speed Northeast Corridor in Train Sim World. Share tracks with express Amtrak services along MBTA’s Providence route, or leave the wires for a stint along the single-track Stoughton branch. In the 3 new scenarios, take on additional challenges such as building formations, and rescuing trains. Check tickets and operate the doors in Conductor Mode.

Work in tandem with the MBTA F40 and single-deck cars, as well as with the capacity-boosting bi-level cars and cab car. With 4 cabs to choose from in push/pull operations, race your way to Boston with the MBTA Providence/Stoughton Line HSP46!

Please Note: For the full experience, we recommend you own Train Sim World 5: Northeast Corridor: Boston - Providence which is available as a separate purchase.

Key Features

  • HSP46 diesel locomotive in MBTA livery

  • BTC & CTC bi-level cars in MBTA livery

  • Highly detailed, feature-rich, driving cabs

  • True-to-life performance, suspension and handling

  • Accessible Tutorials on the Training Center

  • Operate passenger trains across Scenarios and in an alternative Timetable on Northeast Corridor: Boston - Providence, including Conductor Mode

  • Livery Designer, Formation Designer and Scenario Planner compatible. Share your creations with the Creators Club

  • Powered by Dovetail Games’ proprietary SimuGraph® vehicle dynamics engine and Unreal Engine 4® technology

  • Download size: 417.3 MB
